name: Four Point Charge (Combat)
body:
By mimicking how animals run, you can charge further.

Prerequisite: Dex 16.

Benefit: When charging unarmed or wielding a one-handed weapon, you may move your run speed. Any effects that modify your run speed, such as wearing heavy armor, carrying a heavy load, or the Run feat modifies your Four Point Charge as well.

Normal: A character moves twice his speed when charging.
